bored.text: Bored from the UI of your IPTV player?

tired.text: Honestly? I just want to watch something.

meet.text: Meet Aran Plus. A cinematic player for your Roku.

posters.text: Your library becomes posters, not lists, with a big backdrop for whatever you land on.

names.text: Messy provider names are tidied into ones you can read, and sorted by your languages.

asleep.text: Fell asleep halfway through? Continue Watching keeps your place.

follows.text: And with sync set up, it follows you to another TV.

helper.text: Some files won't play on a Roku in any app. The helper on your computer at home converts them while you watch.

subs.text: And subtitles, so everyone can follow along. Found online once, and with sync, saved for every screen.

upnext.text: When an episode ends, the next one counts down on its own.

care.text: Aran Plus. Made with care, for Roku.

player.text: Just a player. It doesn't sell IPTV or playlists.
